title: {{mary}} gets 2 of 3 tools
goal: {{mary}} asks an agent to use {{vocab.toolsThree}} at {{vocab.org}}: search_flights, create_ticket and pay_invoice.
obstacle: {{mary}} is in the analysts group. Policy lets analysts use Search and Ticketing, and nothing lets her use Payments.
control: One Cedar permit per app. A tool no permit covers is denied by default, and the denial names the deciding policy.
say: The agent only gets what {{mary}} is allowed to use, so it cannot be tricked into asking for more.

steps.title: Sign in as {{mary}}
steps.tell: Pick {{mary}} on the sign-in page. Her token carries the group analysts and the scope tools:invoke. The shell shows both.
steps.say: This is {{mary}}'s token. Everything the policy decides, it decides from these claims.
steps.why: Policy reads claims from the access token, never from what the agent says about itself.

steps.title: Search is allowed
steps.tell: In the Tool console call search_flights. The result card says allow, decided by s04-analysts-search-ticketing, and the tool's answer is shown.
steps.say: Search works, and the card names the rule that said yes.
steps.why: An allow is as explainable as a deny.

steps.title: Ticketing is allowed
steps.tell: Call create_ticket. Same policy, same group, a different app.
steps.say: Two of the three tools, one policy.
steps.why: The policy is per app, so Ticketing needed no extra rule.

steps.title: Payments
steps.tell: In the AI Policies tab, open Test a request, pick the finance user (finance group with the payments:write scope) and pay_invoice: allow, decided by s04-payments-finance-only.
steps.say: A finance user with the payments scope gets all three.
steps.why: Payments needs both the group and the scope, so a finance user without the scope is denied too.

blocked.tell: Call pay_invoice as {{mary}}. The result card says deny with the rule default-deny: no permit covers her. Search and Ticketing still work.
blocked.say: Payments is denied with a named reason, and the other two keep working.

steps.title: Read the record
steps.tell: Open the Trace tab. Each call is a row with the auth, cedar, pep and tool hops, the decision and the deciding rule. No token is shown anywhere.
steps.say: Every decision leaves a record you can read to a customer.
steps.why: The proof is the decision and its deciding policy, not a screenshot of an error.

proof.happy: The result card for pay_invoice as the finance user: allow, deciding policy s04-payments-finance-only.
proof.blocked: The result card for pay_invoice as {{mary}}: deny by default-deny, and a Trace row with the same decision.
